description:
Preferred 

Position:
You will play a pivotal role in the application development process and contributes to the development of IT applications and architecture and builds business processes and supporting functions based upon identified business requirements and use cases. You will work as part of a dynamic team environment, engaging with other technical and business professionals focused on building, maintaining and supporting solution frameworks across various industries.
 Responsibilities: 
   At least 1 year of experience with Mulesoft Anypoint API Platform
• Able to interpret requirements to develop Mule services/integrations in CI/CD and Agile process.
• Make technology decisions related to Mulesoft/eCommerce environment
• Create Design Document addressing business paint points around integration leveraging Mulesoft Anypoint API platform.   
• Technically lead and groom a team of developers who might be geographically distributed.   
• Create best practice documents on Mulesoft.
• Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful APIs   
• Broad knowledge of web standards relating to APIs (OAuth, SSL, CORS, JWT, etc.)
• Extensive coding experience with either Java/Spring or Node.js
• Understanding of differences between SOA and API design.
• Knowledge of Change & Incident Management process (CMRs, etc.)
  
  

  
 Nice to Have Technical Skills
 • Experience in Node.js
• NoSql experience (Cassandra, MongoDB, DynamoDB)
• Should be self-starting, requires little oversight and handles complex tasks
• Design and develop REST based APIs leveraging Java platform
• Experience working in a scrum team and in onsite/offshore model.
• Exposure to DevOps.
Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment

 **  U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply .  We are unable to sponsor at this time. 
 Note:- 
 This is a Fulltime job for you 
 Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder, TN Visa, H4-EAD, GC-EAD & L2-EAD can apply. 
 No OPT-EAD  Consultants please.
 
 Please mention your  Visa Status  in your  email   or  resume .
